posts.body_html:
I was just informed that Michael Richard Sprouse passed away April 1, 2025. This is truly sad news, as many of you know, Michael has been a solid part of our community for a very long time. He has always been really nice to me, and he was one of those mellow gardening folks like the rest of you guys! I am confident he spent his very last days on this planet doing what he loved doing, which was growing plants (the recent order I shipped out to him would support this hypothesis). I can only hope he was gazing at a Sarracenia right before his time was up and of course be surrounded by loved ones.

Here is a link to his obituary, I really thought he would be around for a very long time. Life is so precious: www.lambertfuneralhomenc.com/obituaries/Michael-Richard-Sprouse?obId=40750957&fbclid=PAY2xjawJcDoVleHRuA2FlbQIxMAABpud1iT1YJkUvze6BuwevP2K2Uey1cvDiFfhvCpPLGsXO91afHsLDRk9InQ_aem_S9tBxA3IuX8kBjK1fWk68A

I didn’t know him well but from our correspondence he seemed a real genuine nice guy. A big loss to the community.
